# UC-LEARN9 — ID-JAG / Cross-App Access

**Track:** learn  
**Maturity:** ✅ `works`  


## Buyer Story

Cross-app agent access needs a portable identity assertion — not a full federation hop for every resource server.

## PingOne Solution

Identity Assertion JWT Authorization Grant (ID-JAG): the enterprise IdP issues a grant the MCP Authorization Server exchanges for an MCP access token — the token enterprise-managed auth builds on.

## How to Run

**Trigger:** Trigger (edu): `{"type":"edu","panel":"id-jag","tab":"how-it-works","label":"Open ID-JAG panel"}`  
**Expected outcome:** `GUIDED_LEARNING`
